professionalSummary: Maintenance planning coordinator with three years experience at a paper mill operating two paper machines, responsible for building weekly maintenance plans from open work orders under the mill's planning procedure.
experienceHighlights: Built weekly maintenance plans from the open work order backlog using the maintenance system. (src_beb3e9912aa0)
Sequenced shutdown work packages with the two machine crews for monthly shutdowns, with shutdown approval recorded by the production manager. (src_d4c0f1f35471)
Maintained spare parts reservations current for planned work in collaboration with the stores team, reconciling the reservation report each week. (src_ccb7aa8a6b2e)
Prepared weekly plan reviews for the maintenance manager, documenting plan changes and crew feedback. (src_5607dfe74d45)
Authored the plan's open items list and hand‑over conditions for the following week at each review. (src_b97361e89d9d)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: weekly maintenance plan with work order list, shutdown plan with production manager approval, reservation report, and weekly plan review, all linked to maintenance system references. (src_6156a74ebf01)

evidence.text: Maintenance planning coordinator at a paper mill with two paper machines for three years, building each week's maintenance plan from the open work orders under the mill's planning procedure in the maintenance system.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of weekly plan building from backlog.

evidence.text: Sequenced the shutdown work packages with the two machine crews for the monthly shutdowns; the shutdown approval was the production manager's, recorded on the shutdown plan.
Kept the spare parts reservations current for planned work with the stores team, with the reservation report reconciled each week.
Prepared the weekly plan review for the maintenance manager, recording in the review which plan changes I made and which came from the crews' feedback.
Wrote the plan's open items list and the hand-over conditions for the next week's planning at each review.
